items.source: Enum to provide a choice of URI parsers to use in UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(String, ParserType).
items.translation: 用于在 `UriComponentsBuilder.fromUriString(String, ParserType)` 中提供 URI 解析器选择枚举。

items.source: Set the UriComponentsBuilder.ParserType to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的UriComponentsBuilder.ParserType。

items.source: Uses of UriComponentsBuilder.ParserType in org.springframework.web.util
Miscellaneous web utility classes, such as HTML escaping and cookie handling.
items.translation: 杂项 Web 实用类，例如 HTML 转义和 Cookie 处理。
返回配置的解析器类型。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。

items.source: Create a builder that is initialized by parsing the given URI string.
items.translation: 创建一个通过解析给定的 URI 字符串来初始化的构建器。
